name: MEAI
summary: MEAI, also known as 5-methoxy-2-aminoindane (5-MeO-AI) and by its developmental code name CMND-100, is an entactogen of the 2-aminoindane family. It is a cyclized phenethylamine and is the 2-aminoindane analogue of 3-methoxyamphetamine. The drug acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine releasing agent (SNRA), with about 6-fold preference for the release of serotonin over norepinephrine.

pharmacology.text: MEAI acts as a serotonin–norepinephrine releasing agent (SNRA), with a 6-fold preference for induction of serotonin release over norepinephrine release and 20-fold over dopamine release. In addition to inducing monoamine release, MEAI has moderate affinity for the α2-adrenergic receptor. Based on these findings, MEAI may produce MDMA-like entactogenic and sympathomimetic effects and is likely to have reduced misuse liability in comparison.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin–norepinephrine releasing agent (SNRA); Selective serotonin releasing agent (SSRA); Psychoactive drug; Entactogen

uses.text: When used recreationally, MEAI is reported to produce mild to moderate psychoactive effects, including stimulation and euphoria.
